titleEn: Counting Words With a Given Prefix
title: 统计包含给定前缀的字符串
summary: 统计字符串数组中以 pref 开头的字符串数量。
insight: 逐字符串调用前缀比较即可，重复字符串分别计数。
pitfalls: 必须从下标零开始匹配
完整相等也算拥有该前缀
区分大小写但输入为小写

solutions.title: 逐词前缀检查
solutions.idea: 线性检查每个单词是否以 pref 开头。

code.java: class Solution { public int prefixCount(String[] words,String pref){int answer=0;for(String word:words)if(word.startsWith(pref))answer++;return answer;} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int prefixCount(vector<string>& words,string pref){return count_if(words.begin(),words.end(),[&](string& word){return word.rfind(pref,0)==0;});} };
